description: Execute the selected current approach/grasp trajectory, close the gripper, validate actual closure/start/collision state, then execute the planned lift. The first lift has no object attachment, as configured by the user. Preserve partial physical effects on failure; never replay them as an ordinary retry. Return measured execution/holding evidence. Attachment is prepared only after successful lift and holding confirmation.
